name: mySum_append
prelude:
def mySum : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => x + mySum xs
statement: theorem mySum_append (xs ys : List Nat) : mySum (xs ++ ys) = mySum xs + mySum ys
proofs:
induction xs with
  | nil => simp [mySum]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [mySum, ih, Nat.add_assoc]
  have sum_eq (zs : List Nat) : mySum zs = zs.foldr (· + ·) 0 := by
    induction zs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons z zs ih => simp [mySum, ih]
  have offset (zs : List Nat) (a : Nat) : zs.foldr (· + ·) a = zs.foldr (· + ·) 0 + a := by
    induction zs with
    | nil => simp
    | cons z zs ih => simp [ih, Nat.add_assoc]
  rw [sum_eq, sum_eq, sum_eq, List.foldr_append, offset]
strategies: Induction on the left list and associativity of addition.
Characterize mySum as foldr and prove an offset lemma for folds.
